lessons.text: Prepare an answer before you assert: Paramahansa Yogananda broke through with "But note what just happened: your argument skipped the evidence entirely. When the measured results are compared across studies, then the p…" (Clean argument. structure=1.00, evidence=0.50).

Prepare an answer before you assert: Paramahansa Yogananda broke through with "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the premise survives test…" (Clean argument. structure=0.50, evidence=1.00).

Borrow this pattern from Paramahansa Yogananda: "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the premise survives test…" — it answered the opponent directly, it carried evidence, its premises led cleanly to the conclusion.
Your weakest move against Paramahansa Yogananda was "Honestly a four-day week keeps output and improves lives." (soundness 0.65). State its premises and evidence before you use it again.
